system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 28. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (23 seconds, code score 0.94) ---
[b00] JULIANA (screaming, wildly defiant): "Do not speak about my husband!"
[b01] CATHERINE (laughing, scornful): "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."
[b02] CATHERINE (mocking): "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."
[b03] BLOND NOBLEMAN (harsh, authoritative): "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."
[b04] CATHERINE (smug): "And this?"
[b05] CATHERINE (gleeful): "This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate."
[b06] JULIANA (screaming, desperate): "That book is my mother's life's work!"
[b07] CATHERINE (icy, threatening): "Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate..."
[b08] CATHERINE (fateful, vengeful): "...before he sends you to the gallows."

--- WINDOW 1 (21 seconds, code score 0.92) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
[b01] CATHERINE (triumphant, venomous): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
[b02] CATHERINE (mocking, reveling): "I knew I had seen those eyes before."
[b03] CATHERINE (cruel): "The disgraced daughter..."
[b04] CATHERINE (scornful): "...the girl thrown out of her own family home."
[b05] CATHERINE (taunting): "The bride who married a penniless war veteran..."
[b06] CATHERINE (vicious): "...because no respectable man would have her."
[b07] JULIANA (screaming, wildly defiant): "Do not speak about my husband!"

--- WINDOW 2 (44 seconds, code score 0.89) ---
[b00] DOWAGER DUCHESS (trembling, shouting): "I know what happened to me!"
[b01] DOWAGER DUCHESS (fierce, condemning): "I was poisoned!"
[b02] DOWAGER DUCHESS (accusing): "And you... you knew!"
[b03] DOWAGER DUCHESS (choking, weakening): "Catherine knew!"
[b04] DOWAGER DUCHESS (gasping): "They have been—"
[b05] ACTION: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.
[b06] JULIANA (panicked, screaming): "Let me help her!"
[b07] JULIANA (desperate): "She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"
[b08] BLOND NOBLEMAN (smooth, feigning concern): "You see?"
[b09] BLOND NOBLEMAN (sinister): "The poison has clearly damaged her mind."
[b10] DOWAGER DUCHESS (hoarse, straining): "I am not delusional!"
[b11] BLOND NOBLEMAN (condescending, whispering): "Of course you are not."
[b12] BLOND NOBLEMAN (dismissive): "You are merely confused."
[b13] CATHERINE (amused, mocking): "How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."
[b14] CATHERINE (smug): "...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."
[b15] BLOND NOBLEMAN (commanding, resolute): "Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."
[b16] ACTION: Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.
[b17] JULIANA (crying out): "No!"
[b18] CATHERINE (insolent, sneering): "Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?"
[b19] JULIANA (screaming, weeping): "Give it back!"
[b20] JULIANA (anguished): "It belonged to my mother!"

--- WINDOW 3 (37 seconds, code score 0.88) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (venomous): "She looks exactly like a poisoner."
[b01] JULIANA (furious, defiant): "I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"
[b02] BLOND NOBLEMAN (sardonic, chilling): "A clever story, girl."
[b03] BLOND NOBLEMAN (threatening): "But the guards know how to extract the truth."
[b04] DOWAGER DUCHESS (weak, straining): "Rupert..."
[b05] DOWAGER DUCHESS (commanding): "Stop this!"
[b06] DOWAGER DUCHESS (desperate, firm): "She is innocent."
[b07] DOWAGER DUCHESS (adamant): "She saved me!"
[b08] JULIANA (breathless, relieved): "Your Grace..."
[b09] DOWAGER DUCHESS (trembling, shouting): "I know what happened to me!"
[b10] DOWAGER DUCHESS (fierce, condemning): "I was poisoned!"
[b11] DOWAGER DUCHESS (accusing): "And you... you knew!"
[b12] DOWAGER DUCHESS (choking, weakening): "Catherine knew!"
[b13] DOWAGER DUCHESS (gasping): "They have been—"
[b14] ACTION: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.
[b15] JULIANA (panicked, screaming): "Let me help her!"
[b16] JULIANA (desperate): "She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"

Pick the single best promo.
